name: U.S. Bank
notes: Researched from public usbank.com knowledge-base pages only (no sign-in). The mock bill is a U.S. Bank vehicle (consumer) loan. Payments and autopay live under Transfer & pay > Pay bills; autopay amounts are minimum payment, statement balance, minimum payment with extra, or another amount, sent on or before the due date, from a U.S. Bank or external account (added first). Edits/cancels are blocked within 3 business days of the payment date. Paperless under Profile & settings > Paperless preferences; up to 7 years of statements. Payment arrangements are documented for credit cards and lines only, not vehicle loans, so the family payment-plan page is left as is (not marked). Mail (personal installment loans; KB0069699 does not name vehicle loans): East coast U.S. Bank, PO Box 790179, St. Louis, MO 63179-0179; West coast U.S. Bank, P.O. Box 4493, Portland, OR 97208-4493. Two-step verification passcodes go by text (email after confirming the address). No guest pay found (inferred). Reviewed 2026-10-09: mail address corrected to the East/West split.

guest_pay.note: Vehicle loan payments are made after logging in (Transfer & pay > Pay bills). For help call 800-USBANKS (800-872-2657).

help.title: Paying your vehicle loan
paragraphs: In online banking or the U.S. Bank Mobile App choose Transfer & pay, then Pay bills. Select the loan, set the date and amount, pick the account to pay from and confirm. To pay from another bank, add it to your external payment accounts first.

Paying by mail? Follow the instructions on your statement. For personal installment loans, East coast customers mail regular payments to U.S. Bank, PO Box 790179, St. Louis, MO 63179-0179; customers in AK, AZ, CA, CO, HI, ID, MT, NM, NV and UT use U.S. Bank, P.O. Box 4493, Portland, OR 97208-4493.

help.title: Set up autopay
paragraphs: Go to Transfer & pay, choose Pay bills, select your loan and choose Autopay set up now. Enter the amount (minimum payment, statement balance, minimum payment with extra, or another amount), when to send it (on or before the due date) and the Pay from account, then select Start autopay.
Your confirmation shows when the first payment starts. If you just changed your due date, wait until after the new due date to set up autopay.
steps: Select the loan and choose Autopay set up now.
Enter amount, timing and Pay from account.
Select Continue, review, then Start autopay.

help.title: Edit or cancel autopay
paragraphs: Open the Autopay tab under Pay bills, select the account and choose Manage autopay. Update the amount, account or date and save, or choose Remove autopay at the bottom of the form and confirm.
A single pending payment can be edited or cancelled from the Activity tab. Payments cannot be changed or cancelled less than three business days before the scheduled date.

help.title: Paperless preferences
paragraphs: In online banking select Profile & settings, then Paperless preferences (in the app: main menu, Statements & docs). Choose digital delivery for all accounts or for individual accounts and select Save. A change can take one full billing cycle.
Up to seven years of statements are available under Accounts, Statements.

help.title: Request a payoff quote
paragraphs: Choose Request payoff quote, enter a payoff date within the next 30 days, and receive the quote by email or PDF. You can also call 800-USBANKS (872-2657).

help.title: Two-step verification
paragraphs: U.S. Bank sends a one-time passcode to your mobile number when you log in; after you confirm your email address, passcodes can also be sent by email. You can adjust how often you are asked under Profile & settings, Login preferences, but the check cannot be turned off completely.
